headlines.description: Sunderland remain unbeaten in the Europa League thanks to a 1-1 draw against Lech Poznan at the Enea Stadion on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sunderland draw with Lech Poznan to stay unbeaten in Europa League

headlines.description: Bournemouth scaled giddy new heights in their debut Europa League campaign as 10-man AC Milan were convincingly brushed aside 3-0 at the Vitality Stadium on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth notch historic win over Milan after bizarre Maignan red

headlines.description: Jean-Philippe Mateta scored on his first start since the opening day but Crystal Palace could not capitalise on a Besiktas red card to produce a winner in their 2-2 Europa League draw in Istanbul.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crystal Palace settle for draw at 10-man Besiktas
